data.action: 端着白瓷红茶杯坐在皮质沙发上，低头专注审阅文件
data.camera: medium shot, seated on a leather sofa reviewing documents with a teacup
data.description: 【艾莉 · 学生会室·午后对座红茶】安静雅致的学生会办公室里，阳光透过百叶窗在红木桌上划出明暗条纹。身兼副会长的艾莉端起白瓷茶杯轻抿红茶，神情认真而优雅——「今天的会议记录整理得还算及格。不过作为我的搭档，接下来的竞选准备可不能有丝毫松懈哦，政近同学。」
data.lighting: soft natural window light, bright ambient illumination
data.location: 征岭学园学生会办公室
data.promptProse: Alya sits on the student-council room's leather sofa, reviewing meeting documents and lifting a white porcelain teacup for a careful sip. Her dark-brown school blazer and red ribbon retain a formal line in medium view. The mahogany table occupies the near foreground with papers laid across it. Soft afternoon window light passes through blinds, striping the table and highlighting her silver hair above the shaded seat.
